claims.wording: The homepage advertises macOS 14 or later and identifies softwareVersion 1.1.0 in structured data.
claims.conditions: Not binary inspection or proof of latest release; architecture, exact build, signing/notarization and supported on-device-model hardware not verified.

claims.wording: Free scanning and the first 2 GB cleared; Pro advertised at USD 9.99 once, without a subscription.
claims.excerpt: Clears your first 2 GB; $9.99 one payment; priceCurrency USD; Emptying your Trash is free and never counts.
claims.conditions: Free has no trial clock. Tax, regional conversion, future major-version entitlement, metering reset rules and checkout outcome not verified. Do not label the 2 GB a daily quota or claim lifetime updates.

claims.wording: Pro is a personal non-transferable licence, active on up to three Macs at a time, with a stated 14-day refund policy.
claims.excerpt: personal, non-transferable licence; up to 3 Macs at a time; email us within 14 days of buying and we will refund you
claims.conditions: Commercial licence; no verified public source licence. Refund execution not tested; no contact attempted.

claims.wording: The vendor describes a disk map, named/explained items, biggest files and search, including System Data categories.
claims.excerpt: Your whole disk, drawn to scale; Every item named and explained; Biggest files, search, photos by date
claims.conditions: No independent completeness or Full Disk Access test.

claims.wording: Terms say selected rebuildable caches can be permanently deleted after confirmation, with a Trash alternative; other removals go to Trash unless permanent deletion is explicitly chosen.
claims.excerpt: caches that rebuild themselves on their own are deleted permanently ... it also offers to move them to the Trash instead ... Everything else ... moved to the Trash unless you explicitly choose to delete it permanently
claims.conditions: Permanent deletion cannot be undone. Homepage says automated-rule items spend a day in Trash, but nearly-full disks may not wait. Not a universal undo or no-risk guarantee.

claims.wording: Pro advertises snapshot thinning, disk-full warnings/rules, relocation to another drive and app removal with leftovers.
claims.excerpt: Time Machine snapshots thinned; A warning before the disk fills, and rules; Big things moved to another drive; Apps removed with everything they left
claims.conditions: Do not claim Breathing Room uniquely offers monitoring; relocation reliability and exhaustive uninstall coverage untested.

claims.wording: The policy says disk inspection stays local and needs no app account, but Pro activation sends the licence key and Mac name to Dodo Payments; version 1.1+ has switchable usage counts routed through Google Analytics.
claims.excerpt: It also sends the name of your Mac ... anonymous usage counts (version 1.1 and later) ... nothing is sent until you answer that card ... passes them to Google Analytics
claims.conditions: Counts include random ID, app/macOS version, step, size ranges and country; App Store version said to send no counts. Daily update check is also documented. Do not say no network traffic or no telemetry.

claims.wording: The policy describes optional question-answering using Apple's on-device model on supported Macs.
claims.excerpt: On a Mac that supports it, this uses Apple’s on-device model ... summary ... names of categories, sizes and dates
claims.conditions: Exact hardware/OS prerequisites and feature parity with macOS 14 baseline not verified; do not promise it on all supported Macs.

claims.wording: The official screenshot description identifies Xcode build leftovers; exact package-manager cache adapters are not verified.
claims.excerpt: Xcode build leftovers of 7.5 GB and saved website data
claims.conditions: Version 1.0 screenshot description, not a cleanup result or current adapter test.

claims.wording: Breathing Room, which we build, has source implementations for grouped CPU/memory investigation, local activity history and reviewable developer-cache cleanup; it remains a non-notarized macOS 13+ preview with Python 3.10+ caveats.
claims.excerpt: grouped app/process monitoring; developer caches; macOS 13+; Python 3.10+; Apple Development signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized
claims.conditions: Identified preview 0.1.0-preview.1; implementation is not distributed-runtime validation; physical Intel and clean-machine testing remain unverified.

claims.wording: Breathing Room's local core is advertised free; optional hosted AI Care is USD 5/month or 50/year and requires authentication/internet for hosted assistance.
claims.excerpt: $5 USD/month; $50 USD/year; assistant sends the question, conversation history and subsequent tool outputs
claims.conditions: Not all-local AI. Daily care requires running app and exact saved approvals; optional automatic Ruff-cache mode must not be flattened into a universal per-action approval promise. Allowances/paid enforcement unverified.

workflow.primaryIntent: Decide between deleting rebuildable data, retaining unique files, and investigating repeated growth; not a generic cleaner ranking.
outline: Lead with backup and consequence review, not largest-byte totals
Show licensed LighterMac explanation view immediately after lead; historical version caption required
Separate permanent cache deletion, Trash staging and automated-rule timing
Use current-source Breathing Room Space preview to discuss location/method review with explicit example labels
Choose explanatory storage cleanup or app/process investigation without pretending either has exclusive monitoring
workflow.interactionPass: Hand off a local decision checklist: rebuildable? backup? chosen method? automatic-rule timing? No scanner, filesystem calls or fabricated recoverable-size estimate.

structure: Concise qualified recommendation with we-build-Breathing-Room disclosure

advantagesTradeoffs.lightermac: Documented explanatory cleanup and one-time Pro may suit storage-focused readers who prefer that licence model. Warnings/rules, relocation and uninstalling are paid documented scope. Permanent deletion and telemetry conditions need disclosure; none tested here.
advantagesTradeoffs.breathingRoom: Source-level process/helper grouping and activity/developer investigation may suit recurring app-driven growth. Free local core is separate from paid hosted assistance. Preview, Python, non-notarization and runtime validation limits may make it unsuitable for readers requiring a validated production installer.
advantagesTradeoffs.neither: Large size does not authorize removal. Readers only needing a storage overview should consider built-in macOS Storage; any executable tutorial needs separate Apple-primary-source research.
